```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r}

patient_data2 <- read_csv("narratives.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"))

patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
  select(-(37:39))
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
#patient call and transport volume is empty
patient_data2 <- patient_data2|>
  mutate(
    date = mdy_hms(`Incident Date Time`),
    `mm/yyyy` = format(date, "%m/%Y"),
    month = my(`mm/yyyy`),
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 1,
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 2,
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 3,
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 4
    ),
    season_label = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ paste("Winter", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ paste("Spring", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ paste("Summer", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ paste("Fall", year(date))
    )
  )

#Mutating call duration features
#Dispatch -> back in service
#dispatch -> destination
patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
  mutate(
    total_event_duration = difftime( mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Back In Service Date Time (eTimes.13)`), mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), units = "mins"),
    dispatch_destination = difftime( mdy_hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination Date Time (eTimes.11)`), mdy_hms(`Incident Unit Notified By Dispatch Date Time (eTimes.03)`), units = "mins")
  )|>
    mutate(ready = as.numeric(lubridate::hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination To Unit Back In Service In HHMMSS`),
                            units = "mins"
    ))

patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
    mutate(unsched = case_when(
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)" ~ "Second Call",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)"  ~ "Second Call",
    (`Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)` == "Call Turn Over / Mutual Aid") & (`Response Type Of Service Requested With Code (eResponse.05)` != "Mutual Aid (2205009)")  ~
      "Turned Over",
    TRUE ~ "Scheduled"))

patient_data2 <- patient_data2 |>
  mutate(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` = case_when(
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "A" ~ "911 Day",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "B" ~ "911 Night",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "Transfer Shift" ~ "Transfer Shift",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Night" ~ "911 Night",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "911 Day" ~ "911 Day",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)" ~ "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "Event/Standby" ~ "Event/Standby",
    `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)" ~ "No Shift (Second Call)"
  ))
  
```

```{r}

#want to count the patients' number of calls
patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  count(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`, name = "num")|>
  count(`num`, name = "num_patients")|>
  view()

patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  count(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`, name = "num")|>
  ggplot(aes(x = num))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1)+
  labs(title = "Distribution of number of visits for patients")

##Most visits from a patient: 33
## 632 have visited more than once

#seeing how many calls for every patient and viewing only the patients
#who have visited more than once
patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  mutate(num_calls = n())|>
  ungroup()|>
  filter(num_calls > 1)|>
  view()

#Time in between patient calls
patient_time_data2 <- patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  arrange(`date`, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(num_calls = n(),
         returned = if_else(num_calls > 1, "returned", "did not return"),
         prev_visit = lag(date),
         time_between_visits_days = floor(difftime(date,
                                        prev_visit,
                                        units = "days")),
         time_between_visits_hrs = floor(difftime(date,
                                        prev_visit,
                                        units = "hours")))|>
  ungroup()

#Histogram of time between patient return, given that a patient has returned
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(time_between_visits_days))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_between_visits_days))+
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10)+
  labs(title = "Histogram of time between patient return, given that a patient has returned")



#Now by dispatch reason
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(time_between_visits_days))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_between_visits_days))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(~`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`)

patient_time_data2 |>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    time_between_visits_days <= 1, "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs"
  ))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`, 
             fill = factor(within_24_hrs)))+
  geom_bar(position = "stack")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) stringr::str_trunc(x, width = 15))+
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1))+
  labs(
    title = "Return Status by Reason",
    x = "Dispatch Reason",
    y = "Number of calls",
    fill = "Time between visits"
  ) 

patient_time_data2 |>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_days <= 1), "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs"
  ))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`, 
             fill = factor(within_24_hrs)))+
  geom_bar(position = "fill")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) stringr::str_trunc(x, width = 15))+
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1))+
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Return Status by Reason",
    x = "Dispatch Reason",
    y = "Proportion of calls",
    fill = "Time between visits"
  ) 

#it looks like most calls that are returning happen within an hour of the first call... why?
#It looks like that's because the different primary complaints
#duplicated the same events. So I got rid of that.

age_group_data <- patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)`))|>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      is.na(`Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)`) ~ NA_character_,
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 100 ~ "99+",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 90  ~ "90-99",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 80  ~ "80-89",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 70  ~ "70-79",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 60  ~ "60-69",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 50  ~ "50-59",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 40  ~ "40-49",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 30  ~ "30-39",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 20  ~ "20-29",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 10  ~ "10-19",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 0   ~ "0-9",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

return_summary <- age_group_data |>
  group_by(age_group, `Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`) |>
  summarize(
    returned = any(returned == "returned"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(age_group) |>
  summarize(
    n_patients = n(),
    prop_returners = mean(returned),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

time_summary <- age_group_data |>
  group_by(age_group)|>
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

age_group_summary <- time_summary |>
  left_join(return_summary, by = "age_group")

#how many returners return for the same reason? By reason
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  arrange(`date`, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(same_as_last = if_else(
    `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)` == lag(`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`), 1, 0,
    missing = NA_real_))|>
  filter(!is.na(same_as_last))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = "All calls",
         fill = factor(same_as_last))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    name = "Dispatch reason",
    labels = c("0" = "Different from previous", "1" = "Same as previous")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Propotion of Returners Returning for the same reason, by reason",
  x = NULL, y = "Proportion of calls") +
  theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`)

#A little over 25% of returning patients return for the same reason

#Do returning patients have the same illness at a different rate based on how quickly they return?
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  arrange(`date`, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(same_as_last = if_else(
    `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)` == lag(`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`), 1, 0,
    missing = NA_real_))|>
  ungroup()|>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_days <= 1), "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs"
  ))|>
  filter(!is.na(same_as_last))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(within_24_hrs), 
         fill = factor(same_as_last))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Propotion of Returners Returning for the same reason, by time since return and reason")+
  facet_wrap(~`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`)


returned_within_24 <- patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(returned == "returned")|>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_hrs <= 24), "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs",
    missing = "Didn't return"))

returned_within_week <- patient_time_data2 |>
  mutate(within_week = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_days <= 7), "Within a Week", "over a Week",
    missing = "Didn't return"))
```

Now I am interested in looking at times where they use non-scheduled services when there is a transfer the same day
```{r transfer same day, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
#These mutated variables check for if a) there is a transfer on the same day that an event happens and b) if there is a transfer on the same day
is_transfer_on_same_day <- patient_data2 |>
  mutate(date_day = format(date, "%d/%m/%Y"))|>
  group_by(date_day)|>
  mutate(transfer_same_day = if_else(
    any(str_detect(`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`, "Transfer / Interfacility / Palliative Care")), "yes", "no"),
    unscheduled = if_else(
      `EMS Shift (itResponse.005)`==
      regex("No Shift \\(Second Call/Call-In Transfer\\)|No Shift \\(Second Call\\)") |
      `Response Type Of Service Requested With Code (eResponse.05)`==
      "Interfacility Transfer (Unscheduled) (it2205.100)" |
      `Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)` == "Call Turn Over / Mutual Aid",
    "Yes", "No"
  ))|>
  ungroup()

is_transfer_on_same_day|>
  filter(!is.na(unscheduled))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = transfer_same_day, fill = unscheduled)) +
  geom_bar()

is_transfer_on_same_day|>
  filter(is.na(unscheduled))|>
  view()
```


Here I'm going to do one better and look at the calls right before an unscheduled event.


```{r b4unsched, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
before_unscheduled <- patient_data2|>
  mutate(ready = as.numeric(hms(`Incident Patient Arrived At Destination To Unit Back In Service In HHMMSS`),
      units = "mins"
    ))|>
  arrange(date)|>
  mutate(duration_before = lag(total_event_duration),
         event_before = lag(dispatch_destination),
         unit_ready_before = lag(ready))


patient_data2 |>
  select(`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)`, `Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)`)|>
  filter((`Capability of Unit (eResponse.07)` == "Call Turn Over / Mutual Aid") | (`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call/Call-In Transfer)") | (`EMS Shift (itResponse.005)` == "No Shift (Second Call)"))|>
  view()

before_unscheduled|>
  select(total_event_duration, duration_before, dispatch_destination, event_before, ready, unit_ready_before)|>
  view()

#Looking at the distributions of the times for the call before each type of call (sched, second call, and turn over)
before_unscheduled |>
  ggplot(aes(x = event_before, fill = unsched)) +
  geom_density(binwidth = 10)+
  facet_wrap(~unsched)+
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 400)
  )

#This time with the unit ready duration
before_unscheduled |>
  ggplot(aes(x = unit_ready_before, fill = unsched)) +
  geom_density(binwidth = 10)+
  facet_wrap(~unsched)+
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(0, 400)
  )

#So it looks like the time duration of the call before a call hardly influences whether the call will be turned over
```

```{r calls in a day, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
num_calls_before <- patient_data2 |>
  mutate(date_day = format(date, "%m/%d/%Y"))|>
  group_by(date_day)|>
  arrange(date)|>
  mutate(num_earlier_calls = row_number() - 1,
         num_calls_day = n())|>
  ungroup()

num_calls_before |>
  filter(unsched != "Scheduled")|>
  filter(num_earlier_calls == 0 & num_calls_day == 0)|>
  view()

num_calls_before |>
  group_by(date_day) |>
  filter(sum(unsched != "Scheduled", na.rm = TRUE) > 1) |>
  View()

num_calls_before |>
  group_by(date_day) |>
  filter(sum(unsched != "Scheduled", na.rm = TRUE) > 0) |>
  View()

num_calls_before |>
  ggplot(aes(x = num_earlier_calls, fill = unsched))+
  geom_bar(position = "fill")
```
